headline: Chainflip reported theft of 122.86 BTC and an Ethereum outflow estimated at $4.86 million. Norway’s national ID-porten login was disrupted by a denial-of-service attack, and Cyber said it was investigating a bridge incident involving 5.213 million CYBER tokens.

incidents.what: Chainflip confirmed that Bitcoin was stolen in addition to ether and stablecoins, and offered a bounty for returning the funds.
Norway’s digitalisation agency said a denial-of-service attack disrupted its national ID-porten sign-in service.
Cyber reported unexpected minting on Solana and a matching outflow from its bridge on Ethereum; Upbit and Bithumb suspended CYBER transfers.
YMCA confirmed unauthorized access to its Youth For Causes portal but could not determine whether personal data was copied.
OpenRouter warned customers that some prompts sent to MiniMax may have been read and removed the affected endpoints’ zero-retention label.
The Taiwanese company reported an intrusion into its information systems and said it had no material operational impact.
Airbyte restored Intercom after taking Cloud services offline for containment, but 15 other API connectors remained down.
DeFiChain said it expects to reverse the effects of its November exploit and deploy a fix in December; it did not set a date to reopen wallet services.
Travelsoft began restoring the bookings platform in phases after shutting it down following unauthorized access.
The Icelandic provider’s managing director said seven websites were destroyed in the attack and that services would return in phases.
